story.headline: Kamindu Mendis struck 131 off 128 balls, his maiden ODI century, as Sri Lanka posted 325 and set Pakistan a target of 326 in the tri-series final at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore, on Saturday, Dawn reports.

music: Chase It (Instrumental) - JQ, The Red Collective
